## Runs 6–7 — spot checks before the Landau fan
Raw signed Rxx, gate currents, and drain current precede the onset/FFT plots below (`sdh-spot-check`; measure cells 40, 42). Both records completed without clipping: electron Rxx −33…530 ohm at n=+3.2e12, hole −0.4…587 ohm at n=−1.2e12 cm−2; drain current stays 9.81–9.94 nA. Negative longitudinal excursions remain visible; only positive B was measured, so Hall admixture cannot be symmetrized away.

The electron spectrum carries features near 7, 14, 22, 30 T (resolution ~1.8–2.5 T for the 1.5/2–10 T windows). These are candidates, not four independent pockets: harmonic screening and density trajectories remain mandatory. The hole spectrum has ~5–7 T and ~12.4 T content; its available density is in the close-pair exception regime, and an F_L tone is not alone evidence for ABCA. Choose the electron side for its accessible 2.8–3.2e12 design-density interval and shared-density comparison with run 6.

**Onset fork:** default full 0.3–10 T detrending reports a censored ~7 T onset at 0.3 T, whereas degrees 6–7 put this branch near 0.9 T. Low-field sampling below 1 T was coarse (50 mT), and the large 8–10 T MR shoulder biases global-polynomial residuals. Localized `sdh_onset(..., b_hi=4/5)` returns uncensored 1.03/1.02 T for the ~7 T branch; this repeatable local result sets the fan floor (1.0176178808 T). The 6 T fit again produces a censored near-residual ~3 T carrier, showing why the global minimum is not a reliable physical onset here. Frequencies below the selected floor are **not** ruled out. Full-field background-dependent low-frequency claims remain unresolved; no stacking verdict follows from this tuning.

**Design model:** tetralayer `fs_count_b0.abab_fs` at n=2.8/3.0/3.2e12 gives [6.038,22.914]/[6.673,24.351]/[7.306,25.783] T; F_L=28.950/31.018/33.085 T. The fan tests trajectories and Luttinger closure; subsequent analysis must compare ABAB and trilayer models using a single scale, with the ~0.43e12 second-region doping offset from run 5 carried as a confound. Only B_1−B_2 is wired; spatial regions cannot be independently assigned from this one pair. Absolute density remains geometry-prior, and D=0 comes from ridge-A symmetry.

for rid,n in [(6,3.2),(7,-1.2)]:

 B=r.col('magnet_field'); I=r.col(ch['sr0'].col)/ch['sr0'].gain; R=(r.col(ch['sr1'].col)/ch['sr1'].gain)/I
 print('RUN',rid,'complete',r.complete,'interrupted',r.interrupted,'R',R.min(),R.max(),'I nA',I.min()*1e9,I.max()*1e9)
 print('time',r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'],'T',r.col('T_sample').min(),r.col('T_sample').max())
 fig,axs=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(10,8)); axs[0].plot(B,R); axs[0].set(ylabel='signed Rxx (ohm)',title=f'Run {rid}: n={n}e12 cm-2, D~0, B1-B2')
 axs[1].plot(B,r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')*1e12,label='TG');axs[1].plot(B,r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')*1e12,label='BG');axs[1].legend();axs[1].set(ylabel='gate current (pA)')
 axs[2].plot(B,I*1e9);axs[2].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='drain current (nA)');fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot{rid}_raw.png');plt.show()
 on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000); print(on.summary());out[str(rid)]={'onset':on.onset_b,'tones':[dict(freq=t.freq,onset=t.onset_b,censored=t.censored) for t in on.tones]}

 for t in on.tones:axs[0].plot(t.b_centers,t.snr,label=f'{t.freq:.1f} T')
 axs[0].axhline(5,c='k',ls=':');axs[0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='matched-filter SNR');axs[0].legend()
 for lo in [on.onset_b, max(1.5,on.onset_b),max(2.,on.onset_b)]:
  for deg in [3,5]:
   f,sp=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),bg_degree=deg,nfft=4096,log=False)
   pk,_=find_peaks(sp[0],prominence=max(sp[0])*0.05); pk=sorted(pk,key=lambda p:-sp[0,p])[:8]
   print('FFT',rid,lo,deg,[(round(f[p],2),round(sp[0,p],2)) for p in pk]);axs[1].plot(f,sp[0],label=f'lo {lo:.2f}, deg {deg}')
 axs[1].set(xlim=(0,70),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='FFT amplitude');axs[1].legend(fontsize=7);fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot{rid}_fft.png');plt.show()
json.dump(out,open('hera_scratch/spot_onsets.json','w'),indent=2)
# Onset stability: strong 8-10 T MR biases low-frequency tracking in full-span fits.
r=open_run('data/6'); B=r.col('magnet_field'); R=r.col('sr1_X')/(r.col('sr0_X')/-1e6)
for upper in [4.,5.,6.]:
 on=sdh_onset(R,B,b_hi=upper,r_full_scale=5000)

## HERA — compact electron Landau fan for frequency trajectories

> **05:23** · Landau fan: D=0, n=+2.8..+3.2e12 (11), B=1.018..6.5 T (101 uniform 1/B), base T, 10 nA, 3 s/point; field retained · **ETA ~07:33** (≈2h10m)

`landau-fan-vti` (base `landau-fan`), governing `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4. Gate A/B remain green: setup and SAFETIES measure cells 2–32, operator state0 restoration cell 44, bound-kernel probe cell 46; same kernel and E1 grant per handoff. Gate C passed in runs 0–3. Runs 6/7 are now analyzed in ana cells 14–15: electron-side candidate tones ~7/14/22/30 T need density tracking and a Luttinger-aware harmonic screen. Only B_1−B_2 is connected; the two CNP ridges remain a spatial/doping confound, not separately measured regions.

**One floored fan:** n=+2.8…+3.2e12 cm−2 at calibrated ridge-A D≈0, **11 densities × 101 fields**, monotonically 1.01761788→6.5 T, uniform 1/B. Run-6 calibration is retained exactly (TG +0.8690…+0.9836 V, BG +1.0178…+1.1661 V); all points validate without clipping the designed line. The +3.2 column reproduces run 6 on a changed sampling grid. Hole densities and the CNP are excluded: the hole side reaches only −1.27e12 and has the investigation's close-pair ambiguity; n<2.8 on the electron side cannot supply five model-partner periods in this minimal window. Extending down to +2.0 would fail that criterion even at 10 T at the measured onset; a similarly sampled second-side fan would cost another order two hours and would remain a low-density check.

**Binding design arithmetic:** `sdh_onset` on run 6, b_hi=5 T, returns 1.0176178808 T; b_hi=4 gives 1.03 T. Use this local, uncensored onset, retaining the global-background fork documented in ana 14–15 (the full-range fit's censored 0.3 T is not a proven physical onset; no absence claim below our floor). Model ABAB F at n=2.8: 6.038/22.914 T, at n=3.2: 7.306/25.783 T; F_L=28.95…33.09 T. The 1/B record is 0.828841 T−1, δF=1.2065 T and the lowest-density partner gets 5.004 periods; solving five periods gives B_max≈6.47 T, rounded to 6.5. The high-frequency branch has a later ~1.7 T onset: its δF≈2.3 T, so a ~6 T ABAB-to-singleton separation is feasible but absence of a partner is not conclusive. Δ(1/B)=0.0082884 T−1, Nyquist 60.33 T: covers F_L including +20% scale and the ~0.43e12 second-region offset, plus the observed ~59 T harmonic. This is finer than run 6's inverse-B spacing near onset. Δn=0.04e12; at B_lo the g=4 ray period is 0.0984e12, giving 2.46 points/period (2.05 at +20% scale). Thus N_B=ceil(2×60×span)+1=101 and N_n=11 with the scale allowance. A narrow density baseline limits shape discrimination; this is the cheapest branch-tracking test, not a guaranteed final stacking call.

**Acquisition and price:** fixed sr1 sensitivity 50 µV (5 kohm at 10 nA), sr0 20 mV. Run 6's entire 0–10 T range peaks at 530 ohm, run 7 at the much lower hole density at 587 ohm; a conservative 5× low-density extrapolation of run 6 is ~3 kohm, inside 5 kohm. Abort on loss of 10% headroom. Inherit τ=0.3 s and 24 dB slope, with **3 s after each paired gate step** (10τ; magnet settling alone cannot settle the fast gates). Run 5's within-row median was 1.098 s at 1 s dwell; allow 3.25 s/point for the added vaporizer/field readbacks and second gate. 1111×3.25 s=60.2 min; total bare 0→6.5 T ramp is 6.5×7.3=47.45 min, including the 7.43 min positioning leg; 101×5 s row overhead=8.4 min. Subtotal 116 min, priced **2 h 10 min** including 10% contingency. No return traverse is hidden.

**Preflight and checkpoints:** cell prints expected/actual committed validators, fresh base thermometry, both heater ranges off, PS/output enabled, B≈0, Si=0/RNGE2, drive, lock-in τ/slope, NPLC, and operator-owned gate pacing before any writes. All followed channels are recorded and plotted. `hera-watch` is armed before execute: inspect rows 1–3 for leakage/clipping/flat channels and timing; then every ~20 minutes and at B≈2 and 4 T, with interim raw/FFT reads when the record permits. On sustained leakage, lost thermometry, drain failure, or clipping, stop and report; guards retain partial data and hold state. VTI caveat: interrupting a cell does not stop an in-flight magnet ramp—notify Zack for a supply abort; read actual field/gates before any new move. At normal completion park TG/BG at zero, retain B=6.5 T for the next deliberate measurement/close-out decision. Analyze raw Rxx(n,B) first, then compare per-column FFT with run 6, harmonic trajectories, both ABAB/trilayer overlays and one global density scale; carry mosaic, D-offset and positive-B-only limitations.
